title: StagedPlanReply
description: One staged planner reply (ADR-0145 D11): the next stage's steps, ledger reads, questions for the person, or nothing more. Decoded by internal/awareness/planner.go under execution.plan.staged_planner.

reasoning.description: A few sentences on the approach; logged, never executed.

outcome.description: stage: steps hold the next stage; read: ledger_reads; input_required: questions; nothing_more: no further step can help the open items.

cache_policy.description: codegen, cognitive, tool, research or default.

query.description: The complete natural-language instruction for this step.

depends_on.description: Zero-based indices of the steps that must finish first.

required_capabilities.description: Capability tags from <capability_clusters>; empty when none is needed.

required_effects.description: Effects from the effect vocabulary in <capability_clusters> that the step performs; empty for a thought step or a step that only reasons and answers. The runtime adds the configured vocabulary as an enum on items when it sends this schema.

fan_out_over.description: Index of the earlier step whose output is the set to expand over.

fan_out_var.description: Placeholder name used in the query; default item.

preferred_agent.description: An agent ID, only when the request names one.

answers.description: Ids of the requirements items this step produces results for.

inputs.description: Bindings to earlier steps: s<N>, s<N>.<name>, optionally ending in [*].

for_each.description: The set binding an item is answered once per member of, e.g. s0.overdue.

steps.description: The stage's steps; empty unless outcome is stage.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments, as a worker would pass them.

ledger_reads.description: Reads to serve before planning, when outcome is read.

items.description: Ids of the requirements items it blocks.

quote.description: The words of the request it is about, verbatim.

questions.description: Questions for the person, when outcome is input_required.

assumptions.description: What you assumed instead of asking, when the person cannot be asked.
